entry.title: New: browser-automation
entry.summary: Real-browser automation for dsh via an MCP server (Playwright core): navigate, click, fill, type, screenshot, and act on accessibility snapshots with numbered references - all 22 web_* tools re-exposed to the harness over stdio. Exact install spec: github:johnxu22786/browser-automation. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
